name: NextGen Career Clubs, Philadelphia Youth Network
what_you_do: Meet three days a week after school for two hour sessions. You build job skills, earn credentials that employers know, visit workplaces and meet people who work in the field. Members get first pick for paid PYN internships.
who_can_apply: Rising 11th or 12th graders at one of the PYN host high schools in Philadelphia. You must be able to come three days a week after school.
pay_detail: Free career exposure program. The club itself is not described as paid.
duration: 3 days a week, 2 hours a session
deadline_text: The page says it is recruiting at high schools across Philadelphia. No closing date posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Participant Interest Form on the PYN page. Questions: 267-502-3800.
notes: The page also lists a NextGen Career Club (Health Care).
